gemini.rationale: The solar generation assets (T4) crossed the ownership boundary to Capital Dynamics, but the operational and maintenance processes (T5) did not, remaining with the Sponsors via ongoing O&M agreements and a new transition services agreement, creating a mitigated gap_45. No gap_56 exists because the acquired entity had no employees (T6 is null) and the processes did not transfer.

grok.rationale: gap_45=1 because at closing the solar project portfolio (T4) crossed into Capital Dynamics vehicles while 'the O&M Agreements will remain effective after the Closing under the same terms' so day-to-day operating/maintenance processes stayed on pre-existing Sponsor contracts rather than transferring or being internalized. gap_56=0 because those O&M processes did not transfer or get re-engineered away from the Sponsors; the Sponsor-affiliated directors/officers resigned and were expected to remain with the Sponsors, and the Partnership Group had never had employees, so no process-without-organization mismatch was created at closing. The O&M carry-forward plus the negotiated transition services agreement contractually absorbed the shared operating substrate.

openai.rationale: The solar-project portfolio held through OpCo crossed to Capital Dynamics-affiliated acquisition vehicles, while the project-level O&M processes remained with Sponsor affiliates under unchanged service contracts, documenting a product-versus-process ownership mismatch at closing. That gap was contractually absorbed because the O&M Agreements remained effective and transition-services agreements were provided for back-office support. The operating processes remained with the Sponsor organizations that performed them, while the acquired Partnership Group had never employed personnel, so no separate process-versus-organization mismatch is documented.
